name: Corn then soybean
description: Two-year corn and soybean with the field left bare over winter.

name: Corn and soybean with winter cover crops
description: Same cash crops as corn-soybean but the field stays covered in winter.

name: Corn then wheat and double-crop soybean
description: Three harvests in two years. Wheat covers the first winter.

name: Sorghum then wheat and double-crop soybean
description: Swaps corn for drought-tolerant sorghum and keeps a winter crop every year.

name: Alfalfa hay then corn and soybean
description: Three years of alfalfa hay then two years of grain.

name: Summer forage with clover and corn
description: Summer forage grass for grazing or hay then corn with a rye cover.

name: Soybean and radish then corn and rye
description: Adds a deep-rooted radish cover after soybean and rye after corn.

name: Alfalfa hay then three years of corn
description: Matches the CropScape record for the Fallon field: four years of alfalfa then three of corn with bare winters.

name: Alfalfa hay then corn and wheat
description: Long alfalfa stand then corn and winter wheat with summer forage after the wheat.

name: Alfalfa hay then sorghum and corn
description: Swaps one corn year for sorghum which needs less water and adds a rye cover.

name: Shorter alfalfa stand with summer forage
description: Two years of alfalfa then summer forage and corn with rye over both winters.

name: Corn and sorghum with winter wheat
description: Grain only with no hay equipment needed. Wheat and rye cover the winters.

name: Corn every year
description: Corn every summer with the field bare over winter.

name: Soybean every year
description: Full-season soybean every summer with the field bare over winter.

name: Corn then soybean then wheat and double-crop soybean
description: Three-year cycle. Wheat is planted after soybean and double-crop soybean follows the wheat.

name: Wheat and double-crop soybean every year
description: Winter wheat then soybean planted right after the wheat harvest every year.

name: Alfalfa hay field
description: A standing alfalfa hay field cut for hay every year.

name: Peanut then cotton then corn
description: Three-year peanut rotation with grass crops and winter grain covers.

name: Tobacco with rye cover then corn
description: Tobacco followed by a rye cover and grain years to break disease cycles.

name: Hairy vetch ahead of corn
description: A legume cover after soybean supplies nitrogen to the next corn crop.

name: Red clover after wheat then corn
description: Clover sown into standing wheat and kept as hay or cover before corn.

name: Buckwheat after wheat harvest
description: A short summer buckwheat cover in the gap after wheat harvest.

name: Cotton with Austrian winter pea
description: A winter legume cover supplying nitrogen to cotton.

name: Potato with grain and alfalfa
description: Irrigated western potato rotation with a cereal and alfalfa between potato years.

name: Winter canola in a wheat rotation
description: Winter canola breaks up back-to-back wheat.

name: Summer millet and winter triticale forage
description: Year-round forage from a summer annual and a winter annual.

name: Sunflower and wheat
description: Deep-rooted sunflower then wheat and corn with a rye cover.
